text:
Priya (AE): Quick help — BlueRiver POC keeps dropping SSE connections via their edge proxy after ~70s idle. They use our JS/Go SDK and want recommended keepalive pattern, whether keepalives count as tokens, and guidance on short-lived credential TTL (they prefer 5m).

Maya (Solutions): Use transport-level keepalive (SSE comment ping or TCP keepalive). Those do NOT consume model tokens. Only actual inference/generation requests count. If possible, increase proxy idle timeout.

Ethan (Runtime Eng): Confirmed. Transport pings are filtered at the connection layer and won’t hit the batching/serving path. Caveat: Dedicated infra sometimes enforces aggressive idle teardown (~2m) — pinging won't prevent infra-level disconnects.

Priya (AE): If they implement client pings every 25s, will that affect our batching heuristics or billing?

Ethan (Runtime Eng): No. Batching is for incoming generation RPCs. Transport pings are orthogonal. Do NOT send tiny noop generation calls as keepalive — those will be billed and subject to batching.

Jules (Presales): About ephemeral creds: 5m tokens are supported but tight. Recommend 10-15m for POCs to avoid refresh storms. If they insist on 5m, add jitter and backoff to refresh logic.

Maya (Solutions): Example SSE keepalive note to share: "Use SSE comment lines or WS ping frames; set TCP keepalive to 20-30s; avoid generation calls as keepalive." Sample curl refresh flow we can share:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth/refresh \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <refresh-token>" \
  -d '{"scope":"inference"}'
```
Add 10-30s random jitter to rotation.

infra-bot: FYI - Opened ticket RDI-4621 to review Dedicated idle policy for this POC.

Ethan (Runtime Eng): Additional ops tip: if connector replays long system prompts on reconnect to re-warm KV cache, that will cost tokens. Recommend saving a minimal checkpoint (conversation id + small summary) or server-side snapshot to avoid full re-gen. Also cache tool schemas locally to avoid repeated lookups for structured outputs.

Priya (AE): Helpful — I'll send this checklist to BlueRiver and ask for proxy logs. Jules, I'll DM expected QPS if they ask for a short reserved trial. Thanks everyone :pray:
